name: Color Detection in Bounds
hint: A detected color channel ranges from 0 to 255, so color sensing and the reactions based on it remain reliable.
instruction: Keep color comparisons between 0 and 255 and validate readings before using them in decisions.

examples.label: Example
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@codeyB [red v] color value detected :: sensing) > (128)> then
say [Red detected]
end
